# Check your inputs

From the project root:

```bash
python scripts/python/run_workflow.py --data-dir data/my-study --output-dir results/my-study --check-only
```

The command will fail until your prepared inputs exist. Expect your actual row/retained/chromosome counts; there is no universal reference answer.

## Diagnose the problem rather than silence it

| Error or discrepancy | Action |
|---|---|
| Missing/duplicate headers or IDs | Reconcile the source mapping and identifiers |
| Repeated coordinate | Resolve multiallelic or duplicate records upstream |
| Invalid allele pair | Check variant class, capitalization and source strand conventions |
| Zero/invalid p | Obtain valid original probability or log-p information |
| Nonpositive SE | Investigate source coding; do not replace with a small constant |
| Missing/invalid frequency | Resolve the source or document exclusions |
| INFO declared unavailable but numbers supplied | Correct the metadata or the prepared score field |
| Unsupported effect type/build | Extend or prepare the appropriate analysis before use |

Passing validation does not prove correct phenotype coding, build conversion, allele harmonization, population adjustment or cohort independence. Check those against source documentation.

## Review filtering before the full run

Inspect `config/default.json`. Justify its MAF/INFO thresholds for your study. With a custom configuration:

```bash
python scripts/python/run_workflow.py --data-dir data/my-study --output-dir results/my-study --config config/my-study.json --check-only
```

Do not remove records solely to force a preferred figure or p-value pattern. Keep a source-to-prepared audit distinct from the analysis filter audit. `--check-only` does not refresh existing figures.
